name: magentic
summary: Python decorators that turn typed functions into LLM prompts, combining structured outputs, streaming and tool calls with ordinary Python control flow.
description: Install pip install magentic (PyPI 0.41.1; Python 3.10+). @prompt and @chatprompt return values conforming to Python/Pydantic return types. Features include streaming structured results and function calls, LLM-assisted retries, asyncio and OpenTelemetry/Logfire integration. Supports OpenAI, Anthropic and LiteLLM backends and OpenAI-compatible servers; configure provider credentials or a local backend separately. MIT-licensed library.

agent_access.notes: Public source repository; local library. Model services and compute have separate requirements and costs.
